'''Counter-Strike 2'''{{TH|2023-10-26 — 2025-07-28|Natus Vincere|Inactive}} {{TH|2024-09-27 — 2024-11-21|Team Falcons|Loan}} {{TH|2025-05-05 — 2025-07-09|FaZe Clan|Loan}} {{TH|2025-07-28 — '''Present'''|BC.Game Esports}} }} Oleksandr "'''s1mple'''" Kostyliev {{born}} is a [[:Category:Ukraine|Ukrainian]] professional ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' player and a former professional ''[[Counter-Strike: Global Offensive]]'' player. Widely considered as the greatest and most accomplished ''[[CS:GO]]'' player of all time, he has won 21 [[HLTV/MVP Awards|HLTV MVP]] medals, a [[PGL Major Stockholm 2021|Major]] and an [[Intel/Grand_Slam/3|Intel Grand Slam]] trophy, among other numerous [[:Category:S-Tier Tournaments|S-Tier trophies]], and has been crowned as the best player of 2018, 2021, and 2022, and the runner-up for the best player of 2019 and 2020. In late 2023, s1mple announced he would be taking a break from competition, benching himself on [[Natus Vincere]], where he had played since 2017; citing personal reasons and a dislike towards the state of ''[[Counter-Strike 2]]'' at the time. Around one year later, s1mple would have a short loan stint with [[Team Falcons]] and later [[FaZe Clan]], before completing a shock transfer to [[BC.Game Esports|BC.Game]] in mid 2025.
